title: Barely Lasted 4 momths
text: Barely Lasted 4 momths. The design seamed fine. Square made gripping easy. Plastic or acrylic started cracking but did not leak. However, when i tried refilling it was a disaster. I would not purchase again nor recommend this dispenser by M Design.

product_metadata.title: mDesign Modern Square Plastic Refillable Liquid Soap Dispenser Pump Bottle for Bathroom Vanity Countertop, Kitchen Sink - Holds Hand Soap, Dish Soap, Hand Sanitizer, Essential Oils - Clear/Chrome
features: SOAP WITH STYLE: This reusable and refillable dispenser pump holds liquid soap, dish soap, hand sanitizer or essential oils in a stylish and fashionable container; The square, compact design fits on most bathroom sinks and countertops - even small pedestal sinks
GENEROUS CAPACITY: The dispenser pump holds up to 10 ounces and is easy to refill with the removable pump head and wide opening

A DISPENSER FOR EVERY SINK: Place dispensers on bathroom vanity countertops or kitchen sinks to keep soap always at your fingertips; The compact design requires little space on crowded sinks and vanities; Perfect for half baths, full baths, powder rooms, guest bathrooms, pedestal sinks and more; Use in the utility or laundry room - anywhere you need hand soap

QUALITY CONSTRUCTION: Made of durable BPA and Chlorine free plastic; Designed for use in moisture-rich bathroom environments; Will not rust; Easy Care - clean with mild soap and water; Do not place in dishwasher
THOUGHTFULLY SIZED: Measures 2.5" x 3.75" x 6.08" high; Holds 10 oz.
